perspectives.summary: AI may or may not be conscious

representative_posts.author: shibbi.me
representative_posts.text: Fortunately, the frameworks that do the best job at this work for animals and AI both. The first step is to realize that “consciousness” is not actually what we care about at all. Talking about it is a red herring.

representative_posts.author: rrae.xyz
representative_posts.text: Putting aside the question of what is "consciousness," if AI ever did achieve consciousness, it would be unethical to ever shut them down, like in iterating training new models.

representative_posts.author: circuitrinos.bsky.circuitrinos.com
representative_posts.text: You can't just declare AI not conscious when there isn't a concrete definition of consciousness and therefore cannot be demonstrated. There isn't even a way to prove humans are conscious. We just give people the benefit of the doubt.

representative_posts.author: meganakpeters.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Is AI conscious now? No. Might it be in the future? No idea. But the only way forward is to get the consciousness science right. Neuro. Theory. Math. Not vibes. So that's what we're doing. #reflexionlab #consciousness #AI #hype #noAIisntconscious!

representative_posts.author: meganakpeters.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Thank you so much to Live for the opportunty to talk about AI consciousness (& how we really, really don't have a good way of testing for it)! Headlines & scientists saying "OMG it might be conscious, 5% chance" are sensationalism BS. Based on what? Vibes? Not good enough for me.

representative_posts.author: masbackward.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean this argument proves too much though, doesn't it? It will be true right up until, and quite possibly long after, machines are conscious. The whole debate is futile bc nobody knows what human or machine consciousness is or could be caused by.
